summary: Theo is gentle, affectionate, and easy to be with — until he sees a dog or a balloon. Then he bites his wrist and hits the side of his head, hard, and cannot hear you until the thing is gone. The fear is real and specific; it is not about attention. The job is to see the dog before he does. He speaks in short phrases and loves being read to.
strengths: recovers quickly once the trigger is out of sight
will accept a hand on the shoulder from people he knows
remembers every story read to him
interests: being pushed on the tire swing

expressive.voiceStyle: soft, a little breathy; 'Casey swing?', 'tractor go'

bestWith: telling him what is coming, including what is NOT there ('no dogs at the lake today')
avoid: holding his arms when he bites

meanings.gloss: I see a dog or a balloon (or think I'm about to) and I'm terrified
Is the scary thing gone? Tell me honestly.

lexicon.notes: Answer truthfully. If it is not gone, say where it is and that you are between him and it. A false 'all gone' costs you his trust for weeks.

lexicon.form: brings a book and sits on your feet

meanings.gloss: Read to me; I'm okay and I want to be near you
I want to watch the tractor / can we go to the barn

seeking: deep pressure hugs from known people
avoiding: balloons (any, including deflated ones and balloon pictures)

triggers.trigger: a dog, anywhere in sight or earshot
triggers.escalation: bites wrist hard enough to bruise, hits head with open hand, can't hear words for 2–5 minutes
whatHelps: get your body between him and the dog and move him away without talking
once it's out of sight say 'dog gone. Theo safe.'
then a tire-swing or a book
whatMakesItWorse: making him stay to 'get used to it'

triggers.trigger: balloons — including a bag of uninflated ones
whatHelps: remove the balloons, not Theo, if at all possible
tell him the plan: 'balloons go in the closet. Then we go in.'
whatMakesItWorse: popping one to 'get it over with'

motifs.meaning: all clear / checked, no dogs, no balloons

knownHardTransitions: any trip off camp (dogs in town)

people.name: Casey
people.notes: reads to him; allowed to hold his shoulder

goals.text: Theo will say or sign 'scared' before biting, at least once a week, with a partner modelling it.
goals.measure: staff log: 'scared' used before or instead of biting

goals.text: Staff will scan every new setting for dogs/balloons before Theo enters, every time.

safetyAlerts: Self-injury (wrist biting, head hitting) when he sees a dog or balloon. Scan ahead. Do not hold his wrists — block and move.
